dedupe_keys.name: ghana geoportal ghana geo data library on the esri africa geoportal

description: The Ghana GeoPortal is the national site of the Africa GeoPortal run for Ghana GEO, the country's office in the intergovernmental Group on Earth Observations, on Esri's ArcGIS Hub. The home page read on 2026-09-28 says Ghana GEO advances the use of Earth observation data for sustainable development, environmental monitoring and decision-making, working with government agencies, universities and regional organisations on satellite imagery and geospatial data for climate change, disaster risk reduction, agriculture and biodiversity, and it invites users to browse a data library of Ghanaian layers; it names the GEO principal and alternates. Coverage is Ghana. Access is free through the hub; no licence is stated on the home page and layers carry their own sources. Caveats: the data library itself was not listed in the page read, many layers are likely reposted from global sources, and update dates vary. It supports hazard exposure and adaptation studies of Ghanaian infrastructure from land cover, imagery and boundary layers. Related records: no other Ghana geoportal record is catalogued; data-ghana-highway-authority-national-road-network gives the trunk roads.
